firm_data.firm_description: Sacks & Sacks is a New York law firm. One branch of the firm focuses on obtaining compensation and damages for construction workers injured on the job, while another focuses on employment law and commercial litigation.
notable_facts: Secured over two dozen verdicts and settlements in excess of $10 million for construction worker clients.
Drafted amendments to the New York Labor Law in 1969 to expand protections for construction workers.

email.subject: AI for Sacks & Sacks LLP, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Evan,

Your track record securing over two dozen verdicts and settlements in excess of $10 million for construction workers is exactly why I'm reaching out. Firms handling high-stakes cases like construction accidents need tools that match BigLaw precision without the overhead.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in New York to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
